prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” HVAC company that fits everyone — the right choice depends on your exact location in Houston, whether it’s a home or business, the brand/age of your system, how fast you need service, and your budget. I can give specific company recommendations if you tell me your ZIP code and whether this is residential or commercial. Meanwhile, here’s a practical approach and who to look for:

Questions for you
- ZIP code or neighborhood in Houston  
- Residential or commercial?  
- Is this an emergency (no cooling right now)?  
- Any brand/model or warranty on the system?  
- Do you prefer fastest response, cheapest, or best-reviewed/most reliable?

How to pick the best HVAC company
- Licensing & insurance: verify Texas/local contractor registration and liability insurance.  
- Certified technicians: look for NATE-certified techs and manufacturer training on your brand.  
- Reviews & reputation: check Google, Yelp, Angi, and the BBB for recent reviews and complaint history.  
- Transparent pricing: written estimate, diagnostic fee policy, and parts/labor warranty.  
- Parts and warranty: do they use OEM parts? What warranty do they offer on repairs?  
- Response time & availability: emergency/after-hours service if you need it.  
- Local presence: companies with local dispatch and stocked trucks get you fixed faster.  
- References: ask for recent customer references in your area.

Quick troubleshooting you can try now
- Check the thermostat and batteries.  
- Replace/clean the air filter.  
- Make sure the outdoor unit has power (breaker) and is free of debris.  
- Listen for unusual noises or check for ice on the coils (don’t try to melt it yourself).  
If it’s a chemical leak, frozen coils, or compressor issue, shut the system off and call a pro.

If you want, tell me your ZIP code and whether this is residential or commercial and I’ll give 3–5 well-reviewed Houston HVAC companies (with notes on response times, specialties, and what to ask them).
